Super Rare.name: Regretful Rebirth
Super Rare.desc: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Target that monster; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position, but it is destroyed during your End Phase.

Super Rare.name: Warm Worm
Super Rare.desc: If this card is destroyed, send the top 3 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

Super Rare.name: Worm Bait
Super Rare.desc: If you control an Insect monster: Special Summon 2 "Worm Tokens" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). You cannot Normal or Special Summon any Level 3 or 4 monsters the turn you activate this card.
